title: Proof of the Riemann and Generalized Riemann Hypotheses
content: We prove the Riemann hypothesis and the generalized Riemann hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions using the window energy of the Liouville function, whose growth exponent is twice the largest real part of a zeta zero. Each hypothesis is equivalent to one energy bound on a sparse sequence of windows, and that bound follows from a window theorem drawn from the Galois representations of CM fields. The Lindelöf hypothesis, the sharp Pólya–Vinogradov inequality, Vinogradov’s conjectures and cases of Chowla’s conjecture follow.
